clips.text: Everything behind Pixel Reel is open. A reel is just a small file. A title, and a list of scenes.
If you like to tinker, the tools are all there. Make a reel of your own, and draw its pictures in code.
It is free to use, to change, and to share. The licence is called MIT, and it is about as easygoing as licences get.
So come and have a look. The code is on GitHub, under the name pixel reel.
